CustomField.description: On an affidavit request, the name the applicant was first licensed under when it differs from their name now (a legal name change or maiden name since they registered with a school), so the certification can be matched to the old records. Typed by the applicant on the Affidavit Request form.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The name the applicant was first licensed under, if different from their current name.
CustomField.label: Initially Licensed Name
